purpose: Illustrated Ink replay segmentation and image prompt controls for a five-hand Soiru'i refuge ring facing Ninth Furnace registry pressure.

visual_scene_plan.purpose: Click-through anchors for the warm copy-room routine, five office stations, one preparation, Nema's threshold arrival, exposure pressure, the first horn, final strategy, and four aftermath families.
visual_scene_plan.segmentation_rule: Use separate visual_scene_id anchors for room establishment, member and object introduction, routine preparation choices, stateful preparation fold, registrar arrival, registrar response choices, the first-horn threshold, final strategy, and each ending family. Nema's entrance and the first horn each receive a separate click-through beat because they change the room's power geometry.
visual_scene_plan.prompting_rule: Each base image prompt describes a complete drawable frame with room geometry, visible bodies, materials, light, and important objects. Character refs are assembled only for named people visible in that frame. Continuity notes remain tooling constraints and never enter the generated prompt.
visual_scene_plan.global_style_cue: Hand-painted high-fantasy interactive-fiction illustration, gouache and ink on textured paper, strong readable silhouettes, cold charcoal stone and iron against warm furnace-amber light, restrained supernatural ambiguity, practical worn materials, abstract unlettered record marks, dry human intimacy under institutional pressure.
visual_scene_plan.prompt_assembly_rule: Assemble every generated prompt from the global_style_cue, the visual scene's base_image_prompt, visual refs only for visible named characters or groups, and triggered state_image_modifiers or global_branch_image_modifiers. A camera-specific render of the declared scene_set should accompany any multi-angle generation; generated images are painterly outputs, not geometry authority.

scene_set_guidance.scope_reason: The fixture reuses one compact copy room from several focal lengths and moves characters through two doors and one stair. The declared fixed zones, camera slots, sightlines, and branch-state anchors are sufficient for draft replay planning.
scene_set_guidance.future_scene_set_need: Before high-consistency website rendering, make a plan-view or simple 3D blockout of the Ninth Furnace hostel copy room using the declared courtward door, west hostel corridor, north ash-service stair, south heat bench and aid cupboard, central copy table, and threshold clerk positions.

scenes.base_image_prompt: Wide establishing view of a compact rectangular stone copy room inside a geothermal high-fantasy fortress hostel. A heavy iron-strapped door in the east wall opens toward an orange furnace court; a plain west doorway leads to a dim hostel corridor and steaming communal pots; a felt curtain in the north wall hides a narrow descending ash-service stair beside a caged vertical ash chute; a low bronze heat pipe warms a stone bench along the south wall beneath an open aid cupboard. A scarred wooden copy table stands in the center under two oil lamps with rolled parchment, ink, a closed iron-bound branch list, an opened grain jar, a folded wool wrap, and a sealed mortuary answer roll. Five adult human workers occupy separate stations: lean brown-skinned Veka with shaved temples, one black braid and rust-red scribe layers; tall older Melka with deep-brown skin, white head wrap and ash-gray robes; broad older Taru with brown skin, left-cheek scar and dark work wrap; stocky copper-brown Leth with silver-streaked curls, quilted coat and key loops; wiry dark-umber Kera with soot-gray headcloth, cracked-leather apron and corded packet.

visual_continuity_notes: The room is a compact rectangle. East is courtward, west is the hostel corridor, north is the ash-service stair, south is the heat bench and aid cupboard, and the copy table remains central.
The sealed answer roll stays with Melka in every frame unless an ending explicitly shows her carrying it courtward. Taru's household copy is a smaller folded packet inside his wrap.
